notes.title: [Test-Build] Rework Progress (Version 0.1.1a_023)
notes.content:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stats added (local saving only)
[*] Mouse- und touch control buttons added
[*] Stats are showing up on the debug menu now
[/list]

[h3]Design[/h3]
[list]
[*] Library lighting set to a warmer white
[*] Added a few book shelves to the library
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Camera angle and position fixed for library
[*] Lighting bugs fixed
[*] Texture UVs fixed
[*] no more reporting while mouse is over ui elements
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stats will be reset after game restart
[*] There are anomalies, that are triggered more often than others.
[*] aprox. 200 texture UV errors to fix
[/list]

Please report new bugs and ask your questions on the discord server.
